name: pd_maintenance_window_create
description: Create a new maintenance window for a service; alerts are suppressed while the window is active (POST /maintenance_windows)

service_id.description: The ID of the service the maintenance window applies to (maintenance_window.services[].id).

start_time.description: The time at which the maintenance window will start, ISO 8601 (maintenance_window.start_time).

end_time.description: The time at which the maintenance window will end, ISO 8601 (maintenance_window.end_time).

description.description: A description for this maintenance window.

created_by.description: User ID of the requester recorded on the maintenance window.
